population_banner:
POPULATION: this projection covers 68 declared ET-CC members and 39
declared in-population OC checks. That is the slice adjudicated so far,
and it is NOT the whole conformance picture: the full comparison is 281
ET-CC members and 173 in-denominator OC checks, of which 213 members and
120 checks are not_yet_adjudicated -- a third state, distinct from
bucket 1 -- owned by the tickets the crosswalk's own
`outside_the_population` block names. A further 14 checks carry an edge
without being declared by any file, so they are counted in neither.

A count of zero in this view means zero WITHIN THAT SLICE. It does not
mean zero in the suite. As the declared population grows this projection
re-runs and fills.

EVERY FIGURE ABOVE IS INTERPOLATED from the crosswalk being projected;
none is written here. The [population_statement] guard refuses a
population figure that is not.
predicate: Declared-population ET-CC members carrying NO edge in `cells`: the complement of `members_with_edges` over the declared population, taken through `Crosswalk.project(:bucket_1, ...)`. Universe: the 68 declared members, never all 281 members.

rows.field_added_by: MES-108 (C1b-ii), 2026-09-21. These three records came from C1a and predate the `the_search_that_found_none` field. C1b-i rightly REFUSED to backfill a search nobody had run — a field invented after the fact is worse than an absent one. C1b-ii ran it, over the same population and at this tip, so the field is now ADDED rather than invented. The ADJUDICATION is untouched: these three were `declared_unmatched` before and are `declared_unmatched` now, with the same tags and the same members. What changed is that the record says what was read. Three rows sitting silent in a block where ten speak is a difference a reader would have to explain, and the explanation would have been 'nobody looked', which is no longer true.

member.test: test CG2 / T-CG2 — extensions negotiation, both directions the OUTBOUND half (MES-16) still rides every request's _meta

rows.the_near_miss_that_is_not_a_counterpart: The near miss, named — a zero with its near miss named is a search, a bare zero is a grep. The RUN CENSUSES carry `"reason": "extension"` on not_scored scenarios, and a reader meeting the word there could take it for a counterpart. It is not one: those are protocol-extension PACKAGING — scenarios outside the frozen set — and not SEP-2133 capability-extensions negotiation. MEASURED at this tip, on both censuses: 16 of the 20 not_scored entries carry that reason, 6 on the client leg (`auth/client-credentials-jwt`, `-basic`, `auth/enterprise-managed-authorization`, `auth/dpop`, `auth/dpop-nonce`, `auth/wif-jwt-bearer`) and 10 on the server leg (the `tasks-*` family). NOTE — cg-reconciliation.md §2 states this as "seven not_scored scenarios"; that figure does not hold and has not since it was written. The client leg has 7 not_scored ENTRIES, of which 6 carry `extension` — the 7th, `json-schema-2020-12-preservation`, carries `added-after-release`. Over both legs it is 16 of 20. The census has not changed since MES-57 (3e487f8), so this is not drift. The ZERO above is unaffected; the near-miss figure is what was wrong. Recorded here and reported as a finding against cg-reconciliation.md, which is change-controlled and is not edited from this ticket.
rows.the_search_that_found_none: RUN AT THIS TIP BY C1b-ii, not quoted. `/extension/i` over the WHOLE row — scenario + check id + name + description — of all 175 manifest checks in docs/conformance/in-scope-2026-07-28.json returns 0. The sweep is shown to have REACHED that population rather than to have matched nothing for want of running: the same predicate over the same 175 rows returns 45 for `/header/i`, 36 for `/schema/i` and 8 for `/caching/i`. So the zero is a property of the population's content, not of the sweep. Corroborates cg-reconciliation.md §2's E0, which recorded the same zero from the CG side; this one is measured from inside the declared check population.
rows.why_no_counterpart: `no-oc-scenario` — the suite has no such check ANYWHERE, so the search is over all 175 and not over a fixture. SEP-2133 extensions negotiation has no OC check on either leg: A4 §5 measured 0 of 175 and the search recorded above re-measures it here. This is CG2's whole shape and the reason it is a bucket-1 BLOCK rather than a correspondence question — there is nothing to correspond WITH.
